answer: Each tide, the network broadcasts one random signal challenge: every identity must finish a fresh useful job keyed to that signal within two hours, co-signed live by a distinct client, or its 4 POA whisper bond is slashed. The nth identity from one wallet faces n signal challenges per tide and posts 4n² POA (1st 4, 10th 400, 1,540 across ten). One client cannot co-sign two clones, so fakes pay in real clients and real work, not copies.
